module: "Configured camera" framing mode of screenshotCreator: uses a custom camera saved in the vehicle's thumbnail configuration (per config, otherwise per model) and converts it to a world position/rotation from the stored offsets (rewindCameraOffsets). If no configured camera is usable, falls back to procedural framing. It registers itself in the mode list via the onScreenshotCreatorCollectFramingModes hook (id "configured", order 200).
notes: Priority: config camera (configCamEnabled), then model camera (modelCamEnabled), then procedural framing.
resolveOverride returns nil without error when no configured camera applies, and (nil, message) if context.vehicle is missing.
frame is an alias of resolve.

resolve.desc: Resolves the camera for the context: tries the configured camera, otherwise delegates to util_screenshotCreator_framing_procedural.resolve.

context.desc: Framing context: vehicle (required), configName, and the fields read by procedural framing

returns.desc: {pos, rot, name, debugData} or nil on error

resolveOverride.desc: Resolves only the user-configured camera (config then model) without procedural fallback.

context.desc: Framing context with vehicle and configName

returns.desc: {pos, rot, name = 'config camera' or 'model camera', debugData} or nil if no configured camera
Error message if the context is invalid

onScreenshotCreatorCollectFramingModes.desc: Framing mode collection hook: adds the mode {id = 'configured', label = 'Configured camera', order = 200, resolve} to the list.
